answer: Proof, not pledges: Ebony inlayer oak parquetry floor seal inlaid into the cabinetmaker's shop asks for each oak parquetry floor is a measured inlay yield plus a guild signature, and a farm has no honest way to provide it. One forge is a pass, one kernel is a fare, one comet is the stamp on the pass, and the stamp cannot be bought at any price. Farming stops paying when the bill tops the prize, and here the bill is 83148 POA against one epoch's reward. No single office can bless a forgery: the proof must survive three separate keepers.
